1) HARD BREAK: upstream vllm/config/vllm.py renamed the V1 unsupported-feature string from "dflash2 drafts" to "DFlash candidate-head drafts" and renamed _is_dflash2_draft -> _is_dflash_candidate_draft (now also matching LiLiCorrDraftModel). vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_use_v2_model_runner.py:13 still lists "dflash2 drafts", so _patched_get_v1_model_runner_unsupported_features no longer strips it and VllmConfig._validate_v1_model_runner (vllm/config/vllm.py:2015, called in __post_init__) will raise for DFlash2 on the default Ascend V1 runner. Do NOT simply rename the literal: the new string also covers LiLiCorr (which Ascend V1 does not support). Filter conditionally, e.g. remove the item only when the draft architecture is DFlash2DraftModel; update tests/ut/patch/platform/test_patch_use_v2_model_runner.py accordingly.
2) DFlash2 V2 speculator refactor: upstream removed DFlash2Speculator._sample_path and moved it to CandidateSampler.sample, renamed selector_top_k -> top_k, moved _selector_scores/_cached_candidate_ids into self.candidate_sampler, removed _anchor_indices, and added overridable _score_candidates. vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash2/speculator.py inherits _generate_draft, which now calls self._score_candidates() and self.candidate_sampler.sample(); re-verify AscendDFlash2Speculator still works (the module-level patch speculator2_module._selector_walk_kernel = _selector_walk_kernel_ascend in patch_dflash_speculator.py still resolves because CandidateSampler.sample looks it up as a module global, and the positional arg order is unchanged: scores, candidate_ids, sample_pos, idx_mapping, temperature, seeds, draft_tokens, realized_scores). Update the stale docstring/comment referencing DFlash2Speculator._sample_path (line ~49).
3) Quantized context-KV path: upstream DFlashQwen3Model._build_fused_kv_buffers now sets self._fused_kv_weight = None and keeps self._context_qkv_projs/_context_q_sizes when the context QKV is quantized. vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_qwen3_dflash.py:precompute_and_store_context_kv unconditionally calls F.linear(normed_context_states, self._fused_kv_weight, self._fused_kv_bias). Make it handle _fused_kv_weight is None by projecting per-layer through _context_qkv_projs (or explicitly reject quantized DFlash/LiLiCorr drafts on NPU). Also review the new _add_global_draft_layer_exclusions and lm_head quant gating (has_own_lm_head) inherited by DFlash2Qwen3ForCausalLM/DFlash2Qwen3Model.
4) New architecture LiLiCorrDraftModel: upstream adds vllm/model_executor/models/lilicorr.py (LiLiCorrForCausalLM) and routes it in vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/__init__.py to LiLiCorrSpeculator (subclass of DFlash2Speculator). To support it on NPU add a registry entry in vllm_ascend/models/__init__.py, an Ascend model impl, routing in vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/__init__.py (and V1 detection in vllm_ascend/spec_decode/dflash2_proposer.py::is_dflash2_draft, which currently only matches DFlash2DraftModel).
5) LogitsProcessor: get_top_k_tokens gained keyword return_log_probs; LiLiCorrForCausalLM.compute_candidates calls it with return_log_probs=True, which uses generic tensor_model_parallel_all_gather + logsumexp keyed on lm_head.tp_size. AscendLogitsProcessor does not override get_top_k_tokens, and AscendParallelLMHead may use FINE_GRAINED (lmheadTP) or PCP_X_TP parallel modes, so the generic path can produce wrong log-probs/hang. Override get_top_k_tokens in AscendLogitsProcessor (or restrict LiLiCorr to a supported parallel mode) to route through _get_logits_lmheadtp/_get_logits_pcp_weight_sharding.
deep_analysis.risk: medium-high. (a) The unsupported-feature string rename is a silent config-validation regression: any DFlash2 checkpoint on the default Ascend V1 runner will now raise 'Model Runner V1 does not support: DFlash candidate-head drafts' instead of running; a naive string rename would additionally mis-advertise LiLiCorr support on V1. (b) vllm-ascend's DFlash2 support is built on monkey-patching/deriving upstream speculator internals (_selector_walk_kernel, _sample_path, selector_top_k, _fused_kv_weight); this commit rewrites those internals, so the Ascend patch can break at runtime (attribute/name errors or captured-graph mismatch) without any import-time signal; tests/ut/spec_decode/test_dflash2_v2.py only assert the module-level kernel swap, not the new CandidateSampler flow. (c) The new return_log_probs=True path relies on TP all-gather/logsumexp semantics that are not validated for Ascend lmheadTP/PCP heads, risking numerically wrong draft log-probs. Mitigation: one-line-ish patch-string fix is immediate, but full DFlash2/LiLiCorr validation on NPU (V1 and V2, eager and aclgraph) is required.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
No hard compile/runtime break: the new Platform.log_warnings() is a concrete no-op (not abstract), NewLineFormatter/ColoredFormatter only add a keyword-only log_level with default None, and envs.VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL / VLLM_CONFIGURE_LOGGING / VLLM_LOGGING_CONFIG_PATH are unchanged. However, the commit makes `VllmConfig.logging_config` (populated from `--logging-config` / `--log-level`) the authoritative source of log level, so vllm-ascend's own logging must be updated to stay consistent:

1. vllm_ascend/logger.py:
   - `configure_ascend_logging()` and `_setup_file_logging()` currently call `envs.VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL` and `vllm_logger.handlers[0].level`. Change them to accept the resolved `LoggingConfig`/`log_level` (fall back to `envs.VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL` for backward compatibility), then use it for `handler.setLevel(...)` / `ascend_logger.setLevel(...)`. This makes `--log-level DEBUG` and `--logging-config.log_level=...` actually control vllm_ascend logs; without it the new CLI silently does nothing for the `[vllm-ascend]` handler.
   - Instantiate `AscendFormatter`/`AscendColoredFormatter` with `log_level=<resolved level>` (or add an `__init__` that forwards it) because `NewLineFormatter.__init__` now computes `use_relpath` from `log_level` instead of `envs.VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL`; currently they pass no `log_level`, so DEBUG relative-path formatting is lost.

2. vllm_ascend/platform.py:
   - `check_and_update_config()` (calls at lines 464-465) and `NPUWorker.__init__` (worker/worker.py:153-155) should pass `vllm_config.logging_config` (or its `log_level`) into the ascend logging helpers.
   - Optionally implement `NPUPlatform.log_warnings()` now that the base `Platform.log_warnings()` hook exists and is invoked by `vllm.logger._log_platform_warnings()` after `configure_logging()`. This is the migration path for the diagnostics previously hooked at `CudaPlatform.log_warnings()` module import; NPUPlatform is currently a no-op, so this is optional, not required.

3. vllm_ascend/compilation/acl_graph.py:114:
   - Replace `self.is_debugging_mode = envs.VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL == "DEBUG"` with `logger.isEnabledFor(logging.DEBUG)` (mirroring vllm/compilation/cuda_graph.py and breakable_cudagraph.py) so ACL graph debugging honors `--log-level DEBUG`.

4. Tests: tests/ut/test_logger.py and tests/ut/compilation/test_acl_graph.py hardcode envs.VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL for debug-mode assertions; update them if the logging source is switched to `LoggingConfig`.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. All upstream changes are additive/backward compatible (log_warnings is a concrete base method, formatter arg is keyword-only with a default, env vars remain supported), so vllm-ascend still runs unmodified. The risk is a behavior/consistency gap: vllm-ascend's dedicated logger and ACL graph debug mode will not honor the newly introduced `--log-level` / `--logging-config.log_level`, and DEBUG relative-path formatting regresses for Ascend formatters. Env-based configuration continues to work, so failures are cosmetic/log-level only, not correctness.

commits.comment: 在 MoE 模块化路径上扩展 deferred finalize 支持，使 TRTLLM-Gen 的 FP8/MXFP4/NVFP4 modular experts 也能返回 UnfinalizedMoEOutput。核心变更：(1) FusedMoEConfig.defer_moe_finalize 由 bool 字段改为私有 _defer_moe_finalize + 公共方法 defer_moe_finalize(max_num_tokens)/limit_deferred_moe_finalize(max_num_tokens)，use_deferred_moe_finalize 属性增加 hidden_dim == hidden_dim_unpadded 守卫；(2) FusedMoEPrepareAndFinalize.supports_deferred_moe_finalize() 从 Monolithic 专属提升到基类（默认 False），MoEPrepareAndFinalizeNoDPEPModular 返回 True；(3) TrtLlmFp8ExpertsModular / TrtLlmMxfp4ExpertsModular / TrtLlmNvFp4ExpertsModular 的 _invoke_kernel 支持 output=None 时返回 UnfinalizedMoEOutput，并在 __init__ 中调用 limit_deferred_moe_finalize(chunk_size) 以处理 chunked 调用；(4) FusedMoEKernelModularImpl.apply 与大量量化方法（fp8、modelopt、mxfp4、quark、compressed_tensors、inc、online）的 apply 返回类型扩展为 torch.Tensor | UnfinalizedMoEOutput；(5) Kimi-K3 LatentMoERunner 改用新 API。重点是 FusedMoEConfig 的公共 API 破坏性变更。

ascend_impact.functionality: FusedMoEConfig 是对所有 MoE 实现共享的配置类，vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe 及 Ascend 量化适配极可能读取或写入 defer_moe_finalize。直接写 `moe_config.defer_moe_finalize = True` 会覆盖同名方法（不报错但后续 use_deferred_moe_finalize 读取的是方法对象，为真值，行为异常）；直接读 `moe_config.defer_moe_finalize` 作为布尔会得到 bind method（恒真）。正确迁移应改用 `defer_moe_finalize(max_num_tokens)` 与 `limit_deferred_moe_finalize(n)`。此外新增的 hidden_dim == hidden_dim_unpadded 守卫可能改变 Ascend MoE 的 deferred 判定结果。modular_kernel.py 中 apply 返回类型由 torch.Tensor 变为 torch.Tensor | UnfinalizedMoEOutput，若 Ascend 有自定义 prepare_finalize 实现，需同步 supports_deferred_moe_finalize() 语义（默认 False 是安全的，但 NoDPEPModular 变 True 会改变行为）。
ascend_impact.testing: 需要确认 Ascend MoE 相关测试是否依赖 defer_moe_finalize 作为布尔字段；若 Ascend 有自定义 prepare_finalize，需验证 supports_deferred_moe_finalize 的默认返回未导致意外的 deferred 路径。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe（FusedMoEConfig 使用点）
vllm_ascend/quantization（量化方法 apply 返回类型）

commits.comment: 修复 V3.2 sparse MLA 的 KV cache block stride 对齐问题。核心变更：(1) KVCacheSpec 基类新增 `block_stride_alignment: int | None = field(default=None, kw_only=True)` 字段与 __post_init__ 正值校验，把原先 MLAAttentionSpec 的专属字段上提，AttentionSpec 调用 super().__post_init__()；(2) FullAttentionSpec/RSWASpec/SlidingWindowMLASpec/SinkFullAttentionSpec 的 merge 传播该字段，SlidingWindowMLASpec 的 merge 断言要求同组一致；(3) kv_cache_utils._get_kv_cache_bytes_per_block 统一用 lcm 处理 HiSparseHotSpec.page_size_bytes 与所有 per-layer spec 的 block_stride_alignment，不再只针对 MLAAttentionSpec；(4) MLAAttention 引入 _uses_flat_kv_cache() 统一判断（FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE 或非 fp8_ds_mla/nvfp4_ds_mla 的 FLASHMLA_SPARSE），SM100 FlashMLA paged kernels 也设置 block_stride_alignment=state_content_size_bytes；JIT warmup 的 block_stride_rows 计算改为基于同一判断。新增 test_sparse_mla_kv_cache_layout.py 覆盖 BLHNC/BLNHC/LBNHC 三种布局下分配与 warmup 的一致性。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py 属"必然影响"路径：KVCacheSpec 新增 block_stride_alignment 字段与 __post_init__（kw_only），Ascend 的 AscendMLAAttentionSpec、AscendSFAIndexerCacheSpec、AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec 等子类需要 (a) 在 merge 中传播该字段，(b) 若子类有自定义 __post_init__ 必须调用 super().__post_init__()，(c) 在需要特定 block 对齐（如 Ascend 的 block_size=128 约束）时主动设置该字段。kv_cache_utils._get_kv_cache_bytes_per_block 的 lcm 计算把所有 spec（含 Ascend 自定义 spec）纳入，会改变 Ascend 的 bytes_per_block 与 num_gpu_blocks 计算，进而影响 KV cache 内存分配。MLAAttention._uses_flat_kv_cache() 是新增方法，仅作用于 CUDA 后端名，Ascend 后端名不受影响。
ascend_impact.testing: Ascend 需验证 KV cache 分配在有/无 block_stride_alignment 时的一致性与容量计算；若 Ascend 有基于 KVCacheSpec 的布局测试（NZ 格式下的 stride 语义），需适配新字段。

vllm_ascend/attention/（KV cache layout 与 block stride 测试）
vllm_ascend/worker（KV cache 容量计算与 profile_run）

affected_interfaces: vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface.KVCacheSpec.block_stride_alignment (moved from MLAAttentionSpec to the base class as a kw_only field) and new KVCacheSpec.__post_init__ validation -> inherited by vllm_ascend.core.kv_cache_interface.AscendMLAAttentionSpec, AscendSFAIndexerCacheSpec, AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec, AscendIndexerKPoolTailSpec

vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_utils._get_kv_cache_bytes_per_block (single lcm over HiSparse hot pages + block_stride_alignment of every KVCacheSpec, no longer MLA-only) -> reachable through _pool_bytes_per_block which vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_utils.py patches (_ascend_pool_bytes_per_block, _ascend_get_kv_cache_config_from_groups)

vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.mla_attention.MLAAttention.get_kv_cache_spec / bind_kv_cache / new MLAAttention._uses_flat_kv_cache -> inherited by vllm_ascend.attention.mla_v1.AscendMLAAttention and vllm_ascend.models.kimi_k3.AscendKimiMLAAttention

Ascend spec rebuild sites that reconstruct specs from the upstream result without forwarding the new base field: vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py:get_kv_cache_spec (lines ~5974/6004), vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py:get_kv_cache_spec (lines ~170/190), vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v41/dspark.py:DeepseekV41DSparkSWACache.get_kv_cache_spec, vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v41/indexer.py, vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/indexer.py, vllm_ascend/models/glm5next/kv_cache.py
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
The change is largely backwards-compatible: block_stride_alignment is added to KVCacheSpec with a kw_only default of None, so Ascend's frozen/kw_only spec dataclasses keep compiling and produce block_stride_alignment=None (verified: no vllm-ascend code references block_stride_alignment, _uses_flat_kv_cache, or _get_kv_cache_bytes_per_block). Concrete work to do and verify:
(1) vllm_ascend/core/kv_cache_interface.py: AscendMLAAttentionSpec.merge already delegates to super().merge() and then replace(), so it inherits propagation; but AscendSFAIndexerCacheSpec.merge, AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec.merge and AscendIndexerKPoolTailSpec.merge rebuild instances from scratch and silently drop block_stride_alignment. Forward the field (or route through super().merge/replace) and add it to each merge's consistency assertions so the base-class merge invariant is preserved if Ascend ever publishes it.
(2) vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py:get_kv_cache_spec (the AscendMLAAttentionSpec rebuild around lines 5974-6014) and vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py:get_kv_cache_spec (lines 164-200): when downgrading the upstream MLA spec to AscendMLAAttentionSpec, also carry spec.block_stride_alignment (e.g. replace(spec, ...) or block_stride_alignment=spec.block_stride_alignment). Do the same in DeepseekV41DSparkSWACache.get_kv_cache_spec, models/deepseek_v41/indexer.py, models/deepseek_v4/indexer.py and models/glm5next/kv_cache.py where specs are reconstructed.
(3) Audit vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_utils.py (_ascend_pool_bytes_per_block and _ascend_get_kv_cache_config_from_groups). Non-DS4/GLM groups now flow through the new unified _get_kv_cache_bytes_per_block which reads block_stride_alignment from every spec; confirm the DSV4/GLM custom planners still round the per-block stride consistently and that pages/hot pages are not double-counted.
(4) Because AscendMLAAttention inherits MLAAttention.get_kv_cache_spec/bind_kv_cache, the new _uses_flat_kv_cache()/uses_tma_rows branch reads self.attn_backend and self.kv_cache_dtype. Ascend backend names (ASCEND_MLA/ASCEND_SFA/ASCEND_DSA*/ASCEND_DSA_V41_CACHE) short-circuit before current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100), so no failure, but unit fixtures that build MLAAttention.__new__ and call get_kv_cache_spec without attn_backend (e.g. tests/ut/worker/test_attn_utils_v2.py::_make_mla_layer and tests/ut/worker/test_model_runner_v1.py MLAAttention.__new__ cases) should set attn_backend/kv_cache_dtype, mirroring the upstream test-only fix in this commit.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. No current Ascend behavior changes because Ascend custom specs never set block_stride_alignment and Ascend backends do not match the CUDA sparse-MLA predicates; the added field is kw_only with a None default and the new __post_init__ validation only rejects non-positive values. Residual risks are (a) silently dropping block_stride_alignment in Ascend's hand-rolled spec merges/rebuilds, which would diverge from the upstream base-class contract if Ascend later publishes it for sparse MLA, (b) mismatch if Ascend's patched DSV4/GLM pool planners are not updated to mirror the unified lcm rounding, and (c) unit-test fixtures constructing bare MLAAttention instances that now hit _uses_flat_kv_cache.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Remove the now-obsolete OutlinesGrammar terminal short-circuit patch in vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_structured_output.py. Specifically delete _patch_outlines_accept_tokens() (lines ~134-158), the _ORIGINAL_OUTLINES_ACCEPT_ATTR constant, and its module-level invocation at line 163. This commit (upstream #58612) makes OutlinesGrammar.accept_tokens itself detect EOS via the new eos_token_id field and latch _is_terminated, and OutlinesGrammar.is_terminated() now returns that latch instead of polling guide.is_finished(). The vllm-ascend wrapper `if self.guide.is_finished(): return True` executes before upstream's EOS branch, so `_is_terminated` is never set and is_terminated() stays False, defeating the fix. Also update the patch documentation in vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py (entry #20.2), whose stated Future Plan ('Remove this patch once upstream vLLM adds the terminal short-circuit to the outlines backend') is exactly what this commit implements. Optionally guard removal by checking for the new `OutlinesGrammar.eos_token_id`/`_is_terminated` attribute so older pinned vLLM revisions (vllm-ascend currently pins a pre-#58612 main, e6bfe03ad7) still get the old wrapper. The rest of patch_structured_output.py (backend-consistency patches for SamplingParams._validate_structured_outputs and StructuredOutputManager.grammar_init) is unaffected. No vllm-ascend change is needed for the StructuredOutputManager.grammar_bitmask failed_index row-copy logic or for patch_pp_mtp.py's validate_tokens() call, since signatures are unchanged. Verify with tests/ut/patch/platform/test_patch_structured_output.py and the upstream outlines flow tests (tests/v1/structured_output/test_structured_output_manager.py, including test_outlines_termination and test_rejected_draft_keeps_later_rows_constrained).
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. Leaving the wrapper in place after upgrading vLLM silently regresses outlines termination: `accept_tokens` short-circuits on guide.is_finished() before the new code can set `_is_terminated`, so `is_terminated()` never becomes True, the scheduler keeps the grammar active and may log 'Unexpected: grammar terminated or rejected draft token' or emit masks past grammar completion. The failure is runtime-behavioral (no import/compile error), so it will not be caught by type checks; upstream test_outlines_termination would fail. Removal is simple, but a naive removal on an older pinned vLLM revision would re-introduce the original FINISHED_ERROR bug, so either drop the patch together with the vLLM bump or add a feature/version guard.

commits.comment: 修复 enforce_eager 与 JIT warmup 的耦合逻辑。原实现在 model_config.enforce_eager 为真时无条件把 compilation_config.mode/cudagraph_mode 置为 NONE 并把 kernel_config.enable_jit_warmup 置为 False；此次把 enable_jit_warmup 的关闭动作放进 else 分支，当 parallel_config.enable_fault_tolerance 为 True 时保留 JIT warmup（FT 的故障探测依赖 peer deadline，推理过程中 Triton 首次编译的延迟尖峰会导致误判/超时），并相应拆分 warning_once 文案。实现上仅调整 VllmConfig.__post_init__ 内部条件分支，未新增字段或改变接口签名；风险点在于依赖 enable_fault_tolerance 语义（默认 False），即默认路径行为不变，向后兼容。新增 parametrize 测试覆盖 FT 开/关两种组合，断言 compilation_config.mode == NONE 且 kernel_config.enable_jit_warmup == enable_fault_tolerance。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更只影响 VllmConfig.__post_init__ 中 enforce_eager 分支下的 kernel_config.enable_jit_warmup 取值，且仅在 parallel_config.enable_fault_tolerance=True 时改变行为；Ascend 不实现基于对端故障探测的 fault tolerance，默认路径（FT=False）依旧关闭 JIT warmup，NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config 与 AscendConfig 无需同步。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。新增用例位于 tests/compile/test_config.py，属于上游 CUDA/编译路径测试，不涉及 Ascend 平台。

commits.comment: 增强 transformers 后端 RMSNorm fuser 的图匹配能力。新增 _operand(node, index, name) 辅助函数，统一从 node.args / node.kwargs 取操作数，替换原先对 node.args 的位置假设（覆盖 torch.pow(input=..., exponent=...)、mul(input=..., other=...) 等关键字调用形式）；新增 _is_inverse_sqrt 识别 rsqrt(v) 与 pow(v, -0.5)/v ** -0.5 两种等价写法，使 Gemma 4 这类用 pow 表达倒数平方根（且非 zero-centered weight）的模型也能匹配为普通 RMSNorm 融合。测试新增 Gemma4RMSNorm/PowOperatorRMSNorm/KwargPowRMSNorm/KwargBasePowRMSNorm/WeightlessGemma4RMSNorm 等变体，并加入数值等价校验（融合后必须复现未融合 forward，float32 容差 rtol=1e-5/atol=1e-6），说明 pow 与 rsqrt 路径在数值上并非逐位相同。风险在于融合前提判断变宽松，若某模型用 pow(v, -0.5) 表达非标准语义会被误融合，但已用等价性测试兜底。
